summary: The bright vertical portal at the end of the corridor provides a clear, shootable threshold to transition seamlessly into the expansive void space.
route: Camera pushes forward along the reflective floor, passes directly through the glowing vertical portal, and emerges into the open debris field.
threshold: The glowing vertical rectangular opening at the end of the dark corridor.
camera: Continuous forward push along the central axis, aiming through the portal towards the central light source in the void.
parallax: The dark rocky walls of the corridor initially, followed immediately by the floating debris chunks in the new space.
concerns: Managing the exposure and glow during the crossing of the threshold to ensure the environment swap feels like continuous travel
The abrupt change in spatial volume from a bounded tunnel to an open void requires the portal to fully envelop the camera
